responsibility: Defines ELF-specific VAX target options in GCC’s option-table format. In this module it introduces the mno-asm-pic switch, which lets the driver and backend recognize requests to suppress PIC assembler handling even on ELF targets where PIC is otherwise the default, and feeds the option machinery used by elf.h ASM_SPEC processing.
same_name_distinction: Unlike elf.h, this file does not redefine ABI or backend macros for the ELF subtarget; it only declares the ELF-specific target option table entry mno-asm-pic, which the option machinery and elf.h ASM_SPEC use to control assembler PIC handling.
